name: Hats & Rides
author: Lyle Mills
description: 606 and 909-style hats, rides and crashes: analog squares crossfading into a dense cluster read through a 6-bit sample stage.

controls.label: Model
controls.description: Crossfades 606-style analog squares into a 909-style ring-modulated cluster and its 6-bit sample stage.

controls.label: Tone
controls.description: Sets the filters, from dark and woody to bright and thin.

controls.label: Decay
controls.description: Runs from a closed hat through open hat and ride to a crash, with more strike wash as it opens.

controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Spreads the oscillators around their reference ratios; narrower is more bell-like, wider more diffuse.

outputs.main: Mono: the complete hat or cymbal. Stereo: left channel, with offset filters and its own noise.
outputs.aux: Mono: the band-passed body before the high pass and sample stage. Stereo: right channel.

trigger: Strikes the hat or cymbal. Unpatched, the metal sounds continuously with Decay as its level.
